evidence_items.locator: Building the most advanced technology stack for urban driving
evidence_items.explanation: Waymo described contextual reasoning combined with camera and lidar perception before Marcus's post. This complicates the meaning of a new, smarter AI but does not independently establish necessity or freedom from hallucinations.

The research combines a multimodal language model with camera data and driving outputs, showing that statistical learning and physical grounding are compatible. Its benchmark results do not establish deployed safety or prove that this approach is necessary.

The study reports lower injury-related crash rates over 56.7 million driverless miles through January 2025. Safety outcomes alone do not establish whether the system possesses Marcus's proposed capabilities or whether fundamental research was indispensable.

unresolved_gaps: No retrieved study links the safety advantage to a test establishing the necessity of the specified capabilities.
Public descriptions do not establish that a successful deployed system lacks those capabilities, so they do not provide a clean counterexample.
The evidence does not separate indispensable fundamental research from useful research and engineering improvements.
